archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-handoff
archetypes.rationale: Step 8 now depends on bgjob result env and handoff sidecar consistency.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 8 bgjob launcher, child handoff persistence, and ship route-exit validation. Focus on whether non-zero driver rc values still route from current sidecars, while timeout, orphaned, missing, or stale evidence fails closed. Check live-registry rejoin behavior for accidental second driver starts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
